D-147 ledger row quotes 'the unchanged 16.7 ms bound' and 'counting only runs whose docked control is valid' (Q2 OQ6, Mark 2026-11-12): the new text matches. Makefile bench help: 'p99 < 16.7 ms or make nonzero'; m4-6rr3 AC12 is 16.7. Doc line 6: row 7av's 'target p99 <= 16.x' headroom; 16.2 appears only in 7av (R2, R5 jq, Predicted headroom). So the 16.2-as-7av-headroom correction is right and my round-1 own phrasing ('7m AC1's 16.2') inherited the doc's error.

b2/b3/b1 status statements, 'toward AC1 exactly one run (b3)', 'not two valid-control runs (b1 valid, evidence only)', and the (a1,b2,b3 counted; p4 evidence only) / per-source slow-frame metric relabel are true against the recs and raw files. No over-claim; 'one run's evidence, not a spread' is an appropriate bound.

R5's own jq line (line 81, and the b1 table cell '16.669 > 16.2') still tests both docked<=16.7 and transit<=16.2, so 'false' there means 'over the 7av headroom', not 'misses AC12'. b1 (16.669) and none of the others pass 16.7 except b1.
